text: Tokens are never forwarded, so from any use you can walk back to the specific op that defined it. They reuse the existing SSA def-use machinery instead of a parallel system. AnyType excludes them so ops that have not opted in cannot take one by accident; opt in with the Token constraint. They cannot cross IsolatedFromAbove regions such as func.func, so isolated regions can be processed concurrently without races; use a symbol reference in an attribute instead (mlir/docs/Tokens.md).
